0022600141.text: The Utah Jazz (1-3, 1-2 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 0-2 at home, on a one-game winning streak) in the fifth game of the Jazz's 2026-27 season, with Utah 5th in the Northwest and 13th in the West and San Antonio 4th in the Southwest and 9th in the West. There are no games yet between the teams this season, and the Jazz lost their 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 126-109 loss in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
